qualifiedVerdicts.content:
Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 14cc61a and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit c43dd9f found no remaining defect. The 34 lane files (30 new cards and the navigation files kanji/外, words/目下, words/課程 and words/過程) were copied byte-identically from the authoring worktree's local-only scratch commit 2d85e8d; no link was held from an earlier batch, and no follow-up edit from an earlier fix was applied at the candidate. Before the candidate the coordinator read all 30 cards in full against frozen EN and compared the non-title metadata mechanically ("all match except five cards carrying the six RU-added exclusions below"). Its link audit found "no lost links; one RU-only link (狙う → [目指す](目指す.md), accepted below)" and recorded "EN targets not yet published stay plain (kanji 派 身 狙 標 準 仮 推 盆 案 的 典 揮 射 盛 皮 膚; words 地味 平野 撃つ 上司 仮説 退場 トレー 事典 処方する 率直 大盛り)". That list mixes three kinds of item: the 16 written kanji without an RU kanji card (EN links only 準, 皮 and 膚 among them); the two absent EN word link targets 地味 (from 派手) and 平野 (from 盆地); and nine words that EN mentions only in plain text and RU names in prose (撃つ in 発射, 上司 in 目上, 仮説 in 仮定, 退場 in 登場, トレー in 盆, 事典 in 百科事典, 処方する and 大盛り in 盛る, and 率直 in 皮肉). A mechanical count of `.md` link targets in EN finds 6 EN link occurrences to 5 absent RU targets. The coordinator split four RU paragraph merges back into separate paragraphs in 盛る, 盆地, 盆 and 皮膚 ("the drafts merged one EN paragraph into the previous one; the corpus keeps EN paragraph structure; paragraph parity now matches EN for all 30"), removed `quiz_exclusions: []` from 盆地, 百科事典, 発電 and 発射 ("EN has no key on these cards and RU adds none; no-key precedent"), changed 盆's footer URL to `…/wiki/Обон_%28праздник%29` ("parentheses inside a Markdown link target truncate in naive link parsers; page existence re-verified") and reworded examples or prose in 皮膚 («Кожа сухая.»; «…наносят на кожу.»), 的確, 推定, 目安, 標準, 発想 («Интересная мысль.»), 発揮, あたりまえ, 中身, 盗難, 発電, 仮定 and 狙う («целиться в мишень»), mostly for "natural Russian". Fix 1 later changed two of these passages again: 発想:18 now reads «Интересная идея.» (comprehensibility C7), and the split 盛る paragraph on line 23 now opens «Дополнительное сленговое значение — …» instead of «Дополнительное разговорное значение — …» (C8); fix 1 also retitled 皮膚 «кожа; кожный покров» (C10), and the coordinator's 皮膚 example «Кожа сухая.» stands. The coordinator accepted as drafted 派手 目立つ 目次 狙い 目指す 思い込む 目上 案外 思いがけない 皮肉 百科事典 白髪 登場 発射 (plus the edited cards' unchanged prose); the RU-only link 狙う → 目指す ("a substantive synonym comparison where EN has plain text; target in this batch"); the RU-only source footers of 狙う (ru.wiktionary «метить», homonym II) and 盆 (ru.wikipedia «Обон (праздник)»); the six RU-added exclusions below; the dropped English-dependent EN notes (派手 "loud", 盆 "Lantern Festival", 思いがけない "casual", 盆地 "basin" reading remark) and the added RU notes (目次 «Содержание» (≠ 内容); 狙う «метить»); and it left the navigation glosses «неожиданно» (kanji/外) and «предположение» (課程, 過程) unchanged. It recorded the Lopatin spelling of «Бон/Обон» (gramota.ru HTTP 429) under "Unverified Russian (not defects)". Lane validation: "manifest 5,559 files; validate 0 errors; 124 tests OK; budget OK (localZipBytes 8,053,551); link parity: only the accepted RU-only 狙う→目指す link (34 files); navonly 4 files / 4 links / 0 problems; diff --check clean; no BOM/CR/missing EOL in the 35 changed files; paragraph parity with EN for all 30." The candidate script checked that the lane was clean at 2d85e8d with parent bca83ec, that the four navigation files were unchanged between bca83ec and the published HEAD and that no new word file already existed; it copied the 34 lane files, byte-compared every copy with the lane, regenerated the manifest (5,559 entries: 5,554 files, 3 images and 2 scenes) and checked that the changed path set was exactly the 34 batch paths plus manifest.json; its stopping checks (validate, unit tests, budget, `git diff --check` and the navigation-only check over the four files) passed. For this record the 34 committed content blobs at 14cc61a and at c43dd9f were checked: none has a BOM or CR, and every file ends with a newline; link parity at c43dd9f ("checked 34") shows no LOST link and one EXTRA, the reviewed RU-only 狙う → 目指す link. The candidate title screen (b248-cand-screen.txt, 284 lines: 26 OK and 258 !! lines) has one exact-segment line, 狙い–考え «замысел», guarded by 狙い's EN entry 考え. The two later lane screens have the same lines (they differ only in line endings). b248-screen.txt and b248-screen2.txt (284 lines each, the same lines) differ from the candidate screen in two stem-only lines: 目安~純粋 (stem «приме») and 登場~おやすみ (stem «выход») show the published titles of 純粋 (after the Batch 244 fix) and おやすみ (after Batch 245's fix 1) instead of the lane's pre-publication copies; no exact-segment line differs. b248-screen1.txt (288 lines) is an earlier screen with 狙い's pre-adjudication title «прицел; нацеленность; намеченный результат» and without the RU-added guards; it lacks the 狙い–考え exact-segment line. Correctness raised two findings (correctness NEEDS FIX for 目次 and 目立つ; scoped coverage CLEAN for all 30 cards). F1 (medium): 目次:18 «Я нашёл в оглавлении главу, которую хотел прочитать.» asserted a successful find that 探しました does not state; it now reads «Я искал в оглавлении главу, которую хотел прочитать.» F2 (low): 目立つ:19 «Он высокий, поэтому всегда на виду.» added "always" to よく; it now reads «Он высокий, поэтому хорошо заметен.», which also resolves comprehensibility C4. Its optional notes on 発射's English "catapult" and on the English "robbery" and "exhibition" and the source-list references in 盛る, 百科事典 and 白髪 were handled with comprehensibility C1 and C2. Consistency raised no finding (consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN; navigation-only restorations CLEAN; manifest/intake CLEAN) and two optional leads, both adopted by fix 1: O1, 発射 against 飛ばす «запускать (в воздух)», and O2, 登場 against 誕生 «появление на свет; возникновение». Comprehensibility raised ten findings (comprehensibility NEEDS FIX; scoped coverage CLEAN): eight medium (C1–C8) and two low (C9, C10). C1: English glosses in learner prose in 発射:30, 盗難:33 and 発揮:31; 発射:31 now reads «発射 называет действие запуска, а не пусковое устройство.» (the correctness reviewer's wording), the 盗難 robbery sentence is deleted, and 発揮:31 reads «発揮 — не общее слово для выставки: выставку называет [展覧会](展覧会.md)（てんらんかい）.» C2: references to an unseen source in 白髪:33, 百科事典:15 and 盛る:21; the 白髪 and 百科事典 sentences are deleted, and 盛る:21 reads «Но 盛る — не обычный глагол для врача, выписывающего рецепт: для этого есть 処方する（しょほうする）.» C3: 派手:31 now reads «Перед существительным нужно 派手な, а не форма на い.» C4: resolved by correctness F2. C5: 中身's title «содержимое; наполнение» is now «содержимое; суть». C6: 中身:25 now explains «атэдзи»: «словарь помечает это написание как атэдзи: знак выбран по звучанию, а не по значению «вкус».» C7: 発想's title «образ мысли; подход (к задаче); концепция» is now «идея; подход (к задаче)», and its example on line 18 reads «Интересная идея.» C8: 盛る:23 now says «сленговое», and line 37 «Медицинское и сленговое значения не делают все употребления зловещими или сленговыми.» C9: 盆地:18 now reads «В котловине, окружённой горами, поднялся туман.» C10: 皮膚's title «кожный покров» is now «кожа; кожный покров». Its optional notes on 盛る:37 and 皮膚:35 were adopted (盛る with modification): 盛る:37 now ends «…а не указание переводить каждое 盛る словом «накладывать».», and 皮膚:35 «…а не так, будто 皮 и 膚 называют два разных слоя кожи.» All accepted changes are in the one signed fix commit c43dd9f ("Batch 248 fix 1: apply blind-review dispositions"). B248 had one signed fix commit after the blind reviews: fix 1 (c43dd9f) applied the dispositions of all three reviews (14 word cards — 中身, 派手, 発射, 発想, 発揮, 登場, 白髪, 百科事典, 皮膚, 盆地, 盗難, 盛る, 目次, 目立つ — + manifest.json; no navigation-only file changed, so navigation stays at 4 files / 4 links). Each reviewer rechecked the fix diff 14cc61a3..c43dd9f once, serially (comprehensibility, then correctness, then consistency; the initial reviews ran correctness, then consistency, then comprehensibility), read-only, with no generator run; the rechecks were written as separate reports (b248-recheck-{correctness,consistency,comprehensibility}.md).
Comprehensibility (grok-4.7) at c43dd9f reported "Verdicts: comprehensibility CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN" and "Findings: none". It reconciled C1 (発射:30 «発射 называет действие запуска, а не пусковое устройство.»; the 盗難 robbery sentence deleted as redundant with the synonym section; 発揮:31 names 発揮 and keeps the 展覧会 link), C2 (the 白髪 source-list and 百科事典 «Кана источника» sentences gone; 盛る:21 no longer cites an unseen «прописывать»), C3 (派手:31), C5 (中身 «содержимое; суть»; 要旨 excluded), C9 (盆地 «В котловине, окружённой горами, поднялся туман.») and C10 (皮膚 «кожа; кожный покров»; 肌 and 革 excluded) as resolved, and C4 (目立つ:19 «Он высокий, поэтому хорошо заметен.»), C6 (中身 «атэдзи» glossed as chosen for sound), C7 (発想 «идея; подход (к задаче)»; «Интересная идея.») and C8 (盛る «сленговое», matching the Slang tag) as resolved with modification, stating for each that the modification holds. Optional notes 盛る:37 and 皮膚:35 resolved; the declined optionals (目安 length, 狙い «нацеленность», 的確 «по существу», 中身:33, 狙う «окуригана», 発電/能率 «выработка») "None is a false teaching point." It checked the new text in 目次, 登場 and 発射 and found no regression. Its stated limits: unchanged cards not reread in full; JMdict not re-queried; exclusion direction not retested; model not verifiable.
Correctness (gpt-6.1-sol) at c43dd9f reported "Verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN for all 14 changed cards. F1/F2 resolved; no new actionable defect established." It judged F1 resolved (目次:18 «Я искал в оглавлении главу, которую хотел прочитать.»; Daijisen 探す; remedy accepted verbatim) and F2 resolved (目立つ:19 «Он высокий, поэтому хорошо заметен.»; Daijisen よく sense 2 supports degree, with the note that sense 6 permits frequency, so the disposition must not categorically reject that sense), both with high confidence, and corrected its own earlier quotation of EN: EN says "He stands out because he is tall", not "stands out easily"; the finding remains supported. It reread all 14 changed cards against EN and checked every changed passage, including the three retitles (中身 JMdict 1599430 senses 1–2; 発想 1477660 senses 1–2; 皮膚 1483920 sense 1), 盛る «сленговое» against 1379740 sense 6's Slang tag, 派手, 盆地, 発揮, 発射 and the deletions in 盗難, 白髪 and 百科事典 (no necessary sourced claim lost). Japanese examples/kana, front matter except titles/exclusions, footers and ordered link destinations were identical in all 14; original exclusions were retained and only 要旨/革/飛ばす/誕生 added. All six original optional notes resolved; no new optional finding. Sources it reports actually reopened: Jisho/JMdict for twelve entries (eleven changed cards plus 処方), and Digital Daijisen via weblio.jp for 探す, よく, 盛る, 処方 and 盗難. Its stated limits: manifest/tests/device claims in the dispositions not independently validated; no generators, full-corpus quiz audit or repeat review of unchanged cards; CLEAN is a bounded absence of established defects, not exhaustive correctness.
Consistency (claude-sonnet-5.5) at c43dd9f reported consistency, quiz safety, navigation and manifest CLEAN, with "New findings: none". It reconciled O1 (発射 → 飛ばす) and O2 (登場 → 誕生, earlier guards retained) as resolved, its per-card notes on 中身 («наполнение»; 内容, 実 and now 要旨 excluded), 皮膚 (肌, 革 excluded; 皮 also exists) and 発想 (アイデア, アイディア, 考え excluded) as resolved, the other wording fixes as resolved, and the declined remedies and the inherited missing `kango` tag on 的確 and 盆地 as optional. Its title screen of the three retitles found every shared-segment hit guarded; all new exclusion targets exist; H1 equals the title on each retitled card; a repo-wide grep found no remaining old-title gloss. build_manifest in memory equals the committed manifest.json, which differs from 14cc61a3's only in contentVersion and the 14 changed entries; validate.py reported 0 errors. No fix-diff line changed link markup, so link parity is unchanged (the only RU-only link remains 狙う → 目指す; no LOST link) — by diff inspection, without re-running link_parity.py; the 4 navigation files are unchanged. Its stated limits: link_parity.py not re-run; other reviewers' reports not read; linguistic correctness outside its scope.
The coordinator took no further action: no reviewer reported a new finding or an open optional note. No actionable finding remains; no second fix is needed. Fix 1 changed no Japanese example sentence, sourced reading, kanji card, navigation file, EN exclusion or link; it changed fourteen new word files (25 lines added and 24 removed) and the manifest. It retitled 中身, 発想 and 皮膚 and added four exclusions (中身–要旨, 皮膚–革, 登場–誕生 and 発射–飛ばす). No file at c43dd9f outside 皮膚 quotes the old titles of 中身, 発想 or 皮膚. All three reviewers read all 30 new cards in full. The correctness and comprehensibility reviewers compared each with its full EN original; the consistency reviewer compared all 30 with EN programmatically (front matter minus title and the set of `.md` link targets; "It was not a line-by-line prose read."). All three read the four navigation diffs; the consistency reviewer also read the manifest diff and the intake paths, called `build_manifest.build_manifest()` in memory without writing (equal to the committed manifest) and ran `tools/validate.py` (0 errors) at the candidate; the correctness reviewer ran the validator read-only at the candidate (0 errors); the comprehensibility reviewer ran no generator and records no validator run. All three initial reports and all three recheck reports record a clean status. No reviewer ran a generator. Evidence includes the Jisho/JMdict API, Digital Daijisen via Weblio, kanjiapi.dev, ru.wiktionary, gramota.ru, ru.wikipedia and the pinned docs/n2-vocabulary-sources.tsv. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, recheck reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 145 EN exclusions across 26 lists are retained in EN order (EN has no list on 盆地, 百科事典, 発電 or 発射). 14 lie inside the batch: 目立つ–派手, 目次–中身, 狙い–狙う, 目指す–狙う and 狙い, 標準–あたりまえ, 仮定–思い込む, 推定–仮定, 目安–標準, 狙い and 推定, 思いがけない–案外, and 皮肉–案外 and 思いがけない; the other 131 target existing RU cards. Ten direct, one-sided exclusions on eight new cards cover reviewed RU title overlaps, each appended at the end of its list. Six were present at the candidate: 中身–内容 (内容 «содержание; суть»), 推定–観測 and 目安–観測 (観測 «наблюдения и измерения (погоды, небесных тел); прогнозная оценка (развития событий)»), 推定–読み (読み «чтение; оценка ситуации»), 案外–ところが (ところが «однако (вопреки ожиданию)») and 発揮–現れ (現れ «проявление; выражение»). The coordinator accepted them as "発揮→現れ (required: shared «проявление»); 中身→内容, 推定→観測, 推定→読み, 目安→観測, 案外→ところが (conservative)". The consistency reviewer classed 中身→内容 as "REQUIRED", 推定→観測, 推定→読み and 目安→観測 as "CONSERVATIVE", and 案外→ところが and 発揮→現れ as "REQUIRED by title collision", adding "None is unjustified."; the two records therefore differ on 中身→内容 and 案外→ところが. Fix 1 added four: 中身–要旨 (要旨 «основная мысль, суть (доклада, статьи); краткое изложение; аннотация (научной работы)»; comprehensibility C5: "both name the substance or gist of a talk or text, a near-synonym overlap in the sense line 19 teaches"), 皮膚–革 (革 «кожа (выделанная)»; C10: "皮膚 appends 革 so the two «кожа» answers never appear as competing options"), 登場–誕生 (誕生 «появление на свет; возникновение»; consistency O2: "Both name the emergence of something new (新製品の登場 / 新技術の誕生), and the titles share «появление»") and 発射–飛ばす (飛ばす «запускать (в воздух); пропускать»; consistency O1: "JMdict 飛ばす includes a launch sense (ロケットを飛ばす), and the RU titles «пуск (ракеты, снаряда)» / «запускать (в воздух)» overlap in that sense"). 発射 had no quiz_exclusions key at the candidate (the coordinator had removed an empty list) and gains `[飛ばす]`. The candidate title screen (b248-cand-screen.txt; 284 lines) has 26 OK lines for guarded pairs and 258 !! lines; its one exact-segment line, 狙い–考え «замысел», is guarded by 狙い's EN entry 考え. A saved rerun at c43dd9f over the 30 batch words (b248-postfix-screen.txt; 267 lines) has 34 OK lines and 233 !! lines and no unguarded exact-segment line. Its nine exact-segment lines are all OK: 中身–内容, 中身–実 and 中身–要旨 «суть» (guarded by 中身's own list: 内容 RU-added at the candidate, 実 from EN, 要旨 added by fix 1); 狙い–考え «замысел» (狙い's EN entry); 皮膚–肌 and 皮膚–革 «кожа» (皮膚's own list: 肌 from EN, 革 added by fix 1); and 発想–アイデア, 発想–アイディア and 発想–考え «идея» (発想's EN entries). Against the candidate screen it removes 40 lines and adds 23, from the three title changes and the new guards: 発想 32 removed and 15 added, 中身 7 and 5, 皮膚 0 and 2, and 登場 1 and 1 (登場–誕生, a stem-only line, changes from !! to OK). The consistency recheck found every shared-segment hit of the three retitles guarded. Every RU addition is appended at the end of its list, and no EN entry is removed or reordered. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 4 relative links in the 4 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href form (../words/X.md in kanji files, X.md in word files): kanji 外 to 案外 (line 41, a word-list line, matching EN line 39); word 目下 to 目上 (line 33, matching EN line 32); word 課程 to 仮定 (line 33, matching EN line 33; the same line keeps its existing link to 過程); and word 過程 to 仮定 (line 33, matching EN line 33; the same line keeps its existing link to 課程). Each file mentions its target only on the linked line. All four files were copied from the authoring worktree; no link was held from an earlier batch, no surrounding prose changed at the candidate, and no navigation file changed after the candidate. The existing glosses «неожиданно» (kanji/外) and «предположение» (課程, 過程) were left unchanged; the consistency reviewer found the old glosses compatible with the new titles. Unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 87 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 40 of the 72-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (computed after Batch 207 from 2,157 remaining EN words; 957 remained after Batch 247, and 927 remain after this batch). Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing outside them was added. Fourteen source exclusion entries lie inside the batch; the other 131 EN exclusion entries target existing RU cards.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped (6 EN link occurrences, 5 targets) in the new cards: 派手→words/地味, 標準→kanji 準, 盆地→words/平野, 皮膚→kanji 皮 and kanji 膚, and 皮肉→kanji 皮. 16 written kanji have no RU kanji card: 仮 典 射 推 揮 案 標 派 準 狙 的 皮 盆 盛 膚 身 (EN has cards only for 準, 皮 and 膚). Links otherwise follow EN, with one reviewed RU-only link to a card of this batch at a substantive comparison where EN has plain text, present at the candidate: 狙う:29 → words/目指す («[目指す](目指す.md)（めざす）— «стремиться к цели» — пересекается в значении стремления.»; EN 狙う:39 has the plain text "目指す (めざす), \"aim for,\" overlaps in pursuing a goal."). All 8 EN links between batch cards are kept.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined, modified or no-action items: correctness F1 and F2 were accepted with the reviewer's suggested sentences; F2's sentence also resolves comprehensibility C4, whose «часто бросается в глаза» is not used "because the frequency reading is the one F2 disputes". At recheck the correctness reviewer judged F2 resolved but noted that "Daijisen よく sense 2 supports degree; sense 6 permits frequency, so the disposition must not categorically reject that sense". The correctness optional on 発射's "catapult" was accepted with the reviewer's Russian-only sentence, and its optional on the robbery/exhibition/source-list wording was handled with comprehensibility C1/C2; the correctness recheck recorded all six original optional notes as resolved. Consistency O1 and O2 were accepted; its notes on 中身 «наполнение» and 皮膚 «кожный покров» were resolved by C5 and superseded by C10. Comprehensibility C1 was accepted with modification: 発射 uses the correctness reviewer's wording; the 盗難 robbery sentence "is deleted rather than replaced. Line 29 already states «[強盗](強盗.md)（ごうとう）— грабёж с применением силы или угроз; для 盗難 это не обязательно», which is the proposed replacement's content."; and in 発揮 "The subject is named because the preceding sentence is about the object; the EN link to 展覧会 is kept." C2 was accepted, 盛る with modification («Но 盛る — не обычный глагол для врача, выписывающего рецепт: для этого есть 処方する（しょほうする）.»). C6 was accepted with modification: "The deck term «атэдзи» is kept (45 published cards use it) but explained in place". C7 was accepted with modification: "The «подход (к задаче)» parenthetical is kept because line 19 teaches 発想を変える as changing one's approach." C8 was accepted with modification: «сленговое» instead of the suggested «жаргонное» ("JMdict sense 6 tag Slang; EN "slang use"), and line 37 was changed "so the card uses one register label".
